description: React custom hook 'useLlmCostsSummary' that fetches and manages the state of LLM costs summary data from '/api/llm-costs/summary'. It provides loading, error handling, and data state management related to user and project costs with currency information.
external_files: fetch API (built-in, no external file dependencies)

methods.name: useLlmCostsSummary()
methods.description: A React hook that fetches LLM costs summary data from an API endpoint and handles loading and error states.
